name: Shrimp & Bell Pepper Quesadilla with Tomato-Butter Lettuce Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ limes
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop shrimp and place in a large bowl.
Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the shrimp.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, bell pepper, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until bell pepper is tender and shrimp are cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice limes into a clean large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide shrimp-bell pepper filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Top with cheese and fold in half to close. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until tortillas are golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
